title: The researcher wakes the device
assumptions: 8 s / 24 fps / 1280x720 are the project defaults — the user gave none

beats.label: Raises a hand to the button

checks.label: The render is exactly the spec's frame count at the spec's fps
Every subject is where the plan says, facing what it says, at the second it says
checks.note: sheet 0.25-7.8 s: enters frame right by 2.9 s, beside the console by 4.2 s, stands facing the device from 4.5 s

checks.label: Subjects cover their distances at a speed a body can move at
checks.note: travel log: 5.55 m over 0.5-4.5 s, cruise 1.59 m/s - a brisk walk

checks.label: The subject, the prop and the reaction are in frame when the shot is about them
checks.note: sheet: device, console and figure share the frame from 2.9 s to the end; the device is whole at 7.8 s

checks.label: Nothing passes through anything: figure/prop, figure/wall, prop/prop
checks.note: stills 4.2 / 5.4 / 7.8 s: the figure stands beside the console, not in it

checks.label: No effect starts before its cause
checks.note: strip 5.29-5.92 s: device still grey through 5.5 s, first tint after 5.75 s

checks.label: The camera move has no jitter and no overshoot
checks.note: strip 7.21-7.96 s: the push eases out, framing identical from f181 to f192; no jitter

checks.label: The last half second is settled unless the user asked for motion
checks.note: strip 7.21-7.96 s: camera, figure and device still over the last 12 frames

checks.label: The person follows the greybox's path and timing and performs the prompted action
checks.note: compare at 0.25/2.9/4.2/5.0/5.4/5.9/6.6/7.8 s: on the pawn's path and seconds, stops at the pedestal by 4.5 s, left hand on the button at 5.0-5.4 s

checks.label: The body moves naturally: real steps, no gliding, no stiff or extra limbs in motion
checks.note: strip 2.58-3.42 s of the take: real alternating steps, arms swinging, no gliding

checks.label: The take keeps the greybox's camera move
checks.note: compare sheet: push-in matches, ends medium-wide with the whole device in shot

checks.label: The take keeps cause before effect
checks.note: sphere dull grey at 5.4 s with the hand on the button, first blue at 5.9 s, bright by 7.8 s

checks.label: One person, whole limbs, no invented cut, no captions
checks.note: 8 stills and a 21-frame strip: one person, whole limbs, no captions; ffmpeg scene detection found 0 cuts

cost.basis: (8 s out + 8 s ref) x $0.1323/s at 480p
